description: All numeric source inputs are reconstructed from CSV exports created earlier in this ChatGPT conversation; original externally sourced figures were not freshly independently verified.
Machine-readable preservation of exploratory correlations between historical recommended vaccine doses and observed childhood health prevalence.
Vaccination variables are reconstructed recommendation counts and hypothetical scenarios; they do not measure administered vaccine doses or biologic exposure.
Prenatal vaccine counts are modeled hypothetical recommendations rather than a linked mother-infant record.
The 2022 COVID 2-dose and 3-dose scenarios are assigned to 2014-born children ages 7-8, not infancy; these occur after typical autism onset.
Autism is identified prevalence at age 8; ADHD is ever diagnosed at 3-17; asthma at 0-17; obesity at 2-19.
The obesity value of 21.1 assigned to 2022 represents the 2021-2023 NHANES period, not a survey isolated to 2022.
Sum of rates is NOT the percentage of unique children affected and may double-count children with multiple conditions.
Each condition separately reindexed to 2002=100 then averaged, before correlation.
Empty CSV cells indicate missing/not included; no missing values were interpolated.
Profound autism, allergies, diabetes are supplied separately but excluded from the composite because of sparse/nonmatching observations.
High Pearson correlations between trending national series are not evidence of vaccine-related harm or causation; the year-to-year changes correlations differ.
Birth-year alignment uses autism age-8 cohort; applying same modeled exposure to ADHD/asthma/obesity population-wide age groups is a rough proxy.
Vaccine brand/formulation text fields are descriptive categories, not numerical exposure or adverse-event measures.
Coefficient calculation: Pearson correlation on complete paired observations, no imputation. Change correlations use differences of consecutive observed rows.
CDC home/repository URLs are listed for provenance, not proof that each value was directly verified against the linked page during CSV generation.
